verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's Extract API supports schema-based structured data extraction (firecrawl-gh-7) and general extraction to structured JSON (firecrawl-docs-1), which aligns with natural-language/schema-driven extraction rather than manual selectors, but evidence doesn't explicitly confirm free-form natural language prompt extraction quality or reliability, and community feedback raises concerns about robustness and cost-efficiency of the extraction pipeline.
